description: This shell script manages system LED indicators based on different device states such as preinit, failsafe, and upgrade, utilizing functions from external source and controlling LED behavior accordingly.

methods.name: get_status_led
methods.description: Finds and returns the name of the power status LED device.

methods.name: get_failsafe_led
methods.description: Finds and returns the name of the fault indicator LED device.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the LED state based on the input parameter, controlling blinking or static states for different device conditions.
